decision_basis: 28% revenue growth and positive H1 FCF preserve recovery upside, but margin compression survives charge addbacks and H1 FCF fell 30.3%. Substantial future capex and lease demands make 21.17x forward earnings insufficient by itself to favor adding.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager; operating cash is real but the current deterioration is economically material rather than ordinary forecasting uncertainty.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
